name: Matutinal-Almagest
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past towering mountain ranges, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Leviathan fauna breach the sea-mist at dusk, singing on frequencies felt in the teeth.
The colonists of the buried megastructure kept meticulous logs right up to the final entry, which is a shopping list. Rescue charters still quote the coordinates, and still decline the contract.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
